texts: Reworked how builds are handled internally by the code. There should be no functional changes, but the code is cleaner and it should be easier to update it in the future. I tried to test everything that may have been affected, but if something fell through the cracks, please let me know and I will fix it as soon as I can.
Added support for alternative options to identities and E.G.O in Builds and MD Plans (spec build). I'm still thinking of how to best display them, so the exact layout may change over time.
Updated the randomization logic in the Team Draft generator to the same updated one used by the Guessers.
Added Tag Filter to the Theme Packs page. This is a slightly less strict version of the Categories filter.
Added a tag to dev messages in the chat widget.
Fixed an issue where Keyword Modifiers (added keywords to identities when equipping certain E.G.O) did not apply in some cases for the Keyword Distribution display on Builds and MD Plans.
Updated the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service on the site.
